acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on the merge b61d386 (PLAN-108, PLAN-109 and PLAN-110 together): records, palette, lint, types, 1009 tests passed (1 skipped, as before), build. New tests: tests/review-110.test.ts (16) and 4 room tests (a look change or a comeback does not make a turn stale, who left on purpose, the choosing countdown, a finished room).

npm run test:e2e on the merge b61d386: solo game, 0 leaks in 36 frames, abandoned match, quick match, four players plus two computers, 5 reconnect cycles all OK. The speed budget's longest task was over its 200 ms limit on both tries (210, 217 ms) on this machine, so the run ended E2E FAILED on that check alone. Run alone back to back, the merge passed once (193 ms) and failed once (266 ms), while the start commit 0ff8d2c failed all three times (232, 228 ms, and 352 ms to open the game screen against 350): the same range, so the machine, not the change (STATE Known issues; 63 ms on CI). CI on the pull request to main is the deciding run.
